summary.verdict: Do not bulk migrate. Port only the tmux permission-denied liveness correction onto a supported public baseline; prefer the stable re-engagement implementation over the reverted current-main behavior.

commits.subject: Handle tmux liveness check failures under sandboxing
commits.capability: A tmux permission or socket-access failure is unknown liveness and must not be reported as a missing session.

minimum_experiment.reason: The official predicate matches every 'error connecting' string, including permission denial, so the reaper receives false proof of death.

commits.migration_action: Port a narrow Go predicate/test change; do not cherry-pick the TypeScript commit.

commits.subject: Keep Codex orchestrators running autonomously
commits.capability: Route coordination back to an idle orchestrator without granting new authority.
commits.migration_action: Use the stable durable implementation; do not port the old reaction engine.

commits.subject: Repeat sustained idle reactions on cadence
commits.capability: Repeat an idle-orchestrator continuation signal without an unbounded retry loop.
commits.migration_action: Retain the stable bounded retry model; do not port repeatEvery.

commits.subject: Slow idle reaction retries to eight minutes
commits.migration_action: Do not port the literal eight-minute constant.

commits.subject: Stop idle nudges after all work is complete
commits.capability: Stop repeated coordination messages after terminal completion.
commits.migration_action: Use explicit durable completion and bounded exhaustion instead of worker-list heuristics.

commits.subject: Avoid codex tmux paste corruption on long sends
commits.capability: Deliver long or multiline prompts without losing the submission Enter.
commits.migration_action: Use the official chunk, delay, confirmation, and permission-dialog guards.

commits.subject: Preserve idle session status from metadata
commits.capability: Persist idle as a first-class session/activity state.

commits.subject: fix: reconcile ao session branch and ci state
commits.capability: Keep session branch and GitHub CI/review state aligned with live repository facts.

commits.subject: fix(cli): clarify AO running lock permission errors
commits.capability: Distinguish lock contention from permission failure.
commits.migration_action: Do not recreate the retired TypeScript running.json lock.

commits.subject: fix: harden local AO runtime lifecycle
commits.capability: Bound startup readiness, shutdown, process cleanup, session cleanup, and GitHub delivery state.
commits.migration_action: Retain the Go architecture; extract only independently missing safety behavior.

commits.subject: fix: make worker startup and stuck detection fail closed
commits.capability: Do not report a worker started or stuck when workspace, binary, runtime, or observation evidence is incomplete.
commits.migration_action: No wholesale port; preserve official fail-closed transaction and observation model.

commits.subject: fix: resume orchestration after terminal worker epochs
commits.capability: Wake the orchestrator after a worker epoch so closeout or a serial successor can be handled.
commits.migration_action: Use the stable durable loop; do not port the old all-complete fingerprint implementation.

r03_input.reason: v0.11.2 has the required durable re-engagement model but retains the tmux permission-denied liveness misclassification.

required_public_delta.change: Classify only missing tmux session/socket cases as dead; return an error for permission-denied or otherwise unclassifiable probe failures.

limitations: Go was not installed on the audit workstation, so upstream Go tests were not executed in R02.
The source-level minimum experiment is sufficient to identify the predicate defect, but R03 must execute the ported Go unit test and build in a clean fork clone before selecting an artifact.
No old runtime state, credentials, sessions, leases, worktrees, or package links were copied.
No commit from the old checkout was pushed or cherry-picked.
